items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 (widely available) and Mythos 5.2 (restricted via verification programs) as its most capable models for technical work in coding, finance, and sciences. Pricing is $8/$40 per million tokens (20% below 5.1), with up to 30% faster output and an optional fast mode at double the rate.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Fable 5.2（廣泛可用）與Mythos 5.2（透過驗證計畫限制存取），作為其在程式設計、金融與科學等技術工作上最有能力的模型。定價為每百萬token 8美元輸入／40美元輸出（比5.1低20%），輸出速度提升最多30%，並提供雙倍費率的可選快速模式。
items_flat.analysis_en: The dual release continues Anthropic’s pattern of tiered access for high-capability models with stronger safeguards on the open version. Early enterprise uptake and independent coding benchmarks will determine whether the speed and cost gains translate into practical leadership over Opus 5.5 for most workloads.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 雙版本發布延續Anthropic對高能力模型採用分層存取、並在開放版本加強防護的模式。早期企業採用與獨立程式基準測試將決定速度與成本優勢能否在多數工作負載上超越Opus 5.5。
items_flat.quote: We’ve upgraded Claude Fable and Claude Mythos—models that are designed to tackle the most daunting technical challenges.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們已升級Claude Fable與Claude Mythos——專為應對最艱鉅技術挑戰而設計的模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for secure agent purchases
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT Wallet供代理安全完成購買
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, allowing dots (agents) to complete web purchases for US ChatGPT Pro users aged 18+ without accessing real card details. Each transaction requires biometric approval (e.g., Face ID), built with Amex, Mastercard, and Visa; tokens preserve existing card rewards and protections.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT Wallet，讓dots（代理）為美國18歲以上的ChatGPT Pro用戶完成網路購買，而不接觸真實卡片資料。每筆交易需生物辨識核准（如Face ID），與美國運通、萬事達卡及Visa合作；代幣保留既有卡片獎勵與爭議保護。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves agents from recommendation to actual commerce with strong user controls and network-token isolation. Early US Pro-only rollout and biometric friction will test adoption speed versus pure research assistants.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將代理從推薦推進到實際商務，並配備強力用戶控制與網路代幣隔離。僅限美國Pro的早期推出與生物辨識摩擦將測試採用速度，對比純研究助手。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing ChatGPT Wallet, setting a new bar for secure payments by agents. It’s the first wallet that lets agents pay without access to users’ actual card details and that requires a security check for every purchase.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出ChatGPT Wallet，為代理安全支付設立新標準。這是第一個讓代理在不接觸用戶實際卡片資料的情況下付款、且每筆購買都需安全檢查的錢包。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday agentic work
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen供日常代理工作使用
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Hydrogen as a fast, efficient model for coding and agentic workflows, priced at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens flat across 1M context. It is rolling out to the Gemini API, AI Studio, Search, and paid Antigravity users, replacing Gemini 3.8 Flash.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind發布Gemini 4 Hydrogen，作為快速高效的程式設計與代理工作流模型，在1M上下文中平價每百萬token 1.50美元輸入／7.50美元輸出。它正推向Gemini API、AI Studio、Search與付費Antigravity用戶，取代Gemini 3.8 Flash。
items_flat.analysis_en: Hydrogen fills the high-volume/speed tier below Carbon and Argon, aiming to make Gemini 4 widely usable. Independent benchmarks will determine if the claimed speed and quality edge over prior Flash models holds in production agent loops.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Hydrogen填補Carbon與Argon之下的高用量／速度層級，旨在讓Gemini 4廣泛可用。獨立基準測試將決定其宣稱的速度與品質優勢是否在生產代理循環中成立。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，將尖端智慧帶給所有人——為日常程式設計與代理工作流提供速度與效率。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow targeting up to ~$1.4T valuation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic啟動IPO路演，目標估值最高約1.4兆美元
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed Class A common stock IPO on Nasdaq under the symbol ANT. The offering prices shares at $70–$78, with expected pricing around November 18 and trading around November 19, plus a concurrent private placement from cornerstone investors including Google, NVIDIA, and others. Secondary reports indicate the book is several times oversubscribed.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic啟動其擬議的A類普通股IPO路演，將在納斯達克以ANT代號上市。發行股價區間為70–78美元，預期約11月18日定價、11月19日交易，並有包括Google、NVIDIA等基石投資人的同步私募。次級報導指出認購倍數達數倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: The roadshow tests public-market appetite for frontier AI after the SpaceX listing. Reported oversubscription supports the upper end of the range, but final pricing and aftermarket performance remain uncertain amid broader questions about AI spending sustainability.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 路演測試在SpaceX上市後公開市場對前沿AI的胃口。報導的超額認購支持區間上端，但最終定價與上市後表現仍不確定，同時存在對AI支出可持續性的更廣泛疑問。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天Anthropic, PBC啟動其擬議的A類普通股首次公開發行路演。

items_flat.title_en: Meta releases Muse Ember, its smallest efficient model for agent tasks
items_flat.title_zh: Meta發布Muse Ember，其最小高效模型用於代理任務
items_flat.summary_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs introduced Muse Ember, a low-cost model ($0.10/$0.50 per million tokens) designed for high-volume agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, and long-document parsing. It is available on the Meta Model API and Muse Code with a 1M context window.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs推出Muse Ember，一款低成本模型（每百萬token 0.10美元輸入／0.50美元輸出），專為高用量代理工作設計，如工具呼叫、程式子任務、路由與長文件解析。它可在Meta Model API與Muse Code上使用，上下文窗口達1M。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ember targets the cheap worker role that pairs with larger frontier models. Cost leadership claims need independent verification against Haiku 5.5, Luna, and open models before it becomes the default sub-agent choice.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Ember瞄準與較大前沿模型配對的廉價工作者角色。成本領先宣稱需針對Haiku 5.5、Luna與開放模型進行獨立驗證，才能成為預設子代理選擇。
items_flat.quote: Today, we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Muse Ember，我們最小、最高效的模型，專為複雜推理執行與代理全天重複的工作而設計。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic rolls out Claude Meetings beta for Google Meet
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Meetings測試版，支援Google Meet
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic began rolling out Claude Meetings in beta on Team and Enterprise plans. Claude joins Google Meet calls as a visible participant that follows the conversation, answers questions, takes notes, and builds docs or whiteboards in real time; notes and most in-call answers are free during beta.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic開始在Team與Enterprise方案上推出Claude Meetings測試版。Claude以可見參與者身分加入Google Meet通話，跟隨對話、回答問題、做筆記，並即時建立文件或白板；測試期間筆記與多數通話內回答免費。
items_flat.analysis_en: The feature shifts Claude from post-meeting summarizer to in-meeting collaborator, limited for now to Google Meet and paid business plans. Adoption will depend on reliability of live tool use and admin controls around external participants.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此功能將Claude從會後摘要者轉變為會中協作者，目前僅限Google Meet與付費商業方案。採用將取決於即時工具使用的可靠性，以及對外部參與者的管理控制。
items_flat.quote: Claude can now join your video calls as a visible participant, follow the conversation and start on work during the meeting.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude現在可以可見參與者身分加入你的視訊通話，跟隨對話並在會議進行時開始工作。
